description: Mapping used by Sync-CabinetKitFromPosio.ps1 to audit/sync generic cabinet shell updates from posio.cabinet into posio/cabinet-kit.

rules.copy: Files that should stay mechanically mirrored after package-specific prefix/name changes have already been extracted.
rules.manual: Files that share ancestry with posio.cabinet but are intentionally generalized in the package. Review diffs, port ideas by hand.
rules.package_only: Files owned by the package integration layer; they have no source counterpart in posio.cabinet.

entries.notes: Package entry must keep @use partials and --ck-* tokens. Port only generic base layout rules.
Port generic button styles only; keep class contract used by shipped Vue pages.
Translate generic tokens to --ck-*; do not copy Posio product colors blindly.
Port generic card/field shell classes only.
Port generic form field styling only.
Port generic icon sizing helpers only; preserve ck prefix.
Package layout excludes product tour, hints, AI widgets and Posio-specific shared props.
Port only generic header UX. Package uses @cabinet-kit imports and cabinetKit* props.
Source menu is tied to Posio permissions/routes; package menu is config-driven.
Package page keeps only generic settings shell and config-driven tabs.
Port generic account fields only. Product-specific integrations/logo/configuration stay out.
Package tab is intentionally smaller; role UI can be added only if generic.
Package profile tab owns generic name/email/password forms.
Only card shell ideas may be useful; source file is document-specific.
Package table is minimal by design. Port fuller table behavior only after deciding it is generic.
Package model must keep a small schema: owner_id, name, settings, expire.
Port only generic membership/role behavior. No onboarding/demo/product data.
Package repository should not depend on the host repository base class.
Keep Spatie team context behavior generic.
Package route file owns only auth/dashboard/settings/account shell routes.
Composer package integration: migrations/routes/views/config/Inertia paths.
Host scaffolding and install diagnostics.
Override-aware page resolver used by consumer Vite entry.
